name: Tourist / Business / Family Visit Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Purpose-specific supporting documents: travel itinerary and hotel booking (tourism), invitation letter (business), or host's immigration status confirmation (family visit).
Passport valid for at least 6 months.

evidence_required.document: Travel itinerary and hotel booking (tourism), or invitation letter (business)

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 months, single entry; approval authorization itself expires 90 days after issuance if travel has not begun

sources.title: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control, Uganda -- Tourist Visa: USD 50, up to 3 months single-entry, approval authorization valid 90 days from issuance for travel to commence; requires 6-month-valid passport and purpose-specific supporting documents, all in English

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uganda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control (DCIC) sourced, directly fetched by me. This dataset merges the Tourist, Business (short-stay), and Family Visit visa purposes into one file since they share the same USD 50 fee, 3-month duration, and application mechanism (visas.immigration.go.ug), differing only in supporting documentation -- consistent with this dataset's established approach for short-stay visa variants elsewhere. Applications processed entirely online through the Immigration Portal with in-person biometric capture required at an immigration office or border point upon approval.
